title: Propose inline formatting and paste-preservation semantics for numeric and sensitive inputs
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: Users entering numbers (phone, credit card, currency) and sensitive short codes (OTP/password fragments) experience data loss or reformatting when pasting content with separators or invisible characters. Current input components either aggressively reformat on paste (leading to caret jumps and removal of characters) or leave paste untouched (resulting in invalid states and inconsistent mask behavior). This ticket defines design semantics and token interactions to preserve pasted content while maintaining consistent visual formatting, validation feedback, and accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: 1) When a user pastes into a formatted numeric field, raw characters are preserved until the field blur or explicit formatting action; 2) Caret position remains close to user expectation after paste (no large jumps); 3) Validation UI surfaces inline errors without removing user input; 4) Sensitive fields (password fragments, OTP) mask visually after a short delay but keep content intact for assistive technologies; 5) Behavior is defined for desktop and mobile paste, including IME; 6) Implementation points and token overrides are documented for runtime engineers.
design_decisions:
- Adopt 'defer-format-on-blur' as default for complex numeric formats to avoid mid-edit reflow.
- Provide an optional 'auto-normalize' toggle in component props for power users and programmatic inputs (used by payment flows).
- Use a 700ms visual masking delay for OTP/password fragments for usability, with aria-live announcement to inform screen reader users.
- Validation is non-destructive: visual error states do not strip characters; instead show suggested correction with one-tap quick-fix affordance.
- Token mapping: introduce input.token.formatBehavior with values 'live', 'defer', 'none'.
accessibility_notes:
- For screen reader users announce paste events: 'Pasted 16 characters, formatting deferred' using polite aria-live.
- Ensure masking delay is communicated via aria-describedby.
- Avoid moving DOM focus on paste; use visual caret stabilization heuristics.
- Document IME flows: during composition events, no formatting runs until compositionend.
risks_and_tradeoffs:
- Defer-format-on-blur reduces immediate visual consistency which may confuse some users; mitigated by inline hint and quick-format button.
- Adding token behavior increases surface area for platform engineers; we recommend sensible defaults and migration guide.
- Masking delay introduces timing choice; too short reduces usefulness, too long reveals sensitive input momentarily.
qa_checklist:
- Paste phone number with spaces and dashes: raw preserved until blur; formatted on blur.
- Paste credit card number containing non-breaking spaces and letters: non-digit characters preserved in raw but flagged as suggestion.
- Paste OTP from clipboard on mobile: first visible then masked after 700ms; screen reader announces paste.
- IME composition paste: no formatting until compositionend.
- Keyboard-only flows: quick-format button reachable via Tab and operable with Enter/Space.
